title: With nothing ticked Activate is disabled and its hover text says why
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Create a part, part A, for this test and set it inactive.
  • Start on the Inventory page, on the Inactive tab, with part A's part number typed in the Search box.
custom_steps:
1. Click the three-dot actions button (⋮) in the toolbar, to the left of New Inventory Part.
  2. Click Activate parts.
  3. Hover over Activate on the dark bar.
  4. Click Activate.
  5. Click the part A row.
  6. Hover over Activate.
  7. Click the X at the right end of the dark bar.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The menu opens.

Step 2:

  • Bulk mode turns on with nothing ticked.

Step 3:

  • The Activate button is shown but dimmed (disabled), and hovering it shows "Tick the parts to activate".

Step 4:

  • Nothing opens: no "Activate parts?" confirmation appears.

Step 5:

  • The bar reads 1 selected.

Step 6:

  • With 1 row ticked the button is bright blue (enabled) and no hover text appears.

Step 7:

  • Bulk mode ends and part A is still on the Inactive tab.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, version 33 (23 Oct 2026, owner Chris Ward), read 27 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10647, story SV-10816 (Story 3, Activate Parts in Bulk)

  • S3-N1: “With nothing ticked, the Activate button is visible but disabled.”
  • S3-R3: “S2-R3 to S2-R10b, S2-R14 to S2-R17 and S2-N3 apply on the Inactive tab exactly as on the Active tab, with "deactivate" read as "activate". The disabled button's hover text is "Tick the parts to activate".”
  • User Feedback Summary: “Activate hovered with nothing ticked | "Tick the parts to activate" | Tooltip on the disabled button”
